countercases.disposition: Retained; without a live cited measurement the desk names the gap instead of inventing a rate.
countercases.statement: A recorded interference indicator can arise from measurement conditions rather than a general filtering policy.

dek: Multiple scoped instruments report observable network interference, while their incompatible panels, protocols and denominators rule out one national percentage.

gates.detail: The abstention names the missing live measurements without inventing citations.
gates.label: Every analytical sentence has exact evidence IDs

gates.detail: The report includes all three adversarial-review surfaces.
gates.label: Countercases, limitations and falsifiers are explicit

falsifiers.statement: The observable-interference finding would weaken if independently operated China and control vantages converged within instrument error across repeated windows.
falsifiers.test: Repeat predeclared protocols over multiple windows and compare China/control distributions with retained raw denominators.

falsifiers.statement: A national-rate estimate would become testable only after a representative sampling frame and common outcome definition exist.
falsifiers.test: Publish the sampling frame, inclusion probabilities, shared protocol, nonresponse accounting and uncertainty interval before estimating a population rate.

hypotheses.statement: Network interference affecting China-facing tests is observable across independently produced measurement methods.
The headline values estimate one common national filtering rate.

limitations.consequence: No weighted average or single national percentage is calculated.
limitations.statement: The instruments observe different test populations with different denominators and units.

limitations.consequence: The desk publishes an abstention rather than a filtering rate.
limitations.statement: Live rights-eligible network measurements were unavailable. Excluded: ooni-gfw (not-live), in-path-interference (not-live), censored-planet (LINK_ONLY/metadata_only), and inside-view (not-live).

methodology.description: Hash the exact four public input files and validate their declared schemas.
Resolve predeclared network values and denominators against JSON pointers in their exact raw artifact bytes.
Republish and count only values whose mesh resource permits derived or full-text reuse with open or attribution-required redistribution.
Resolve independence groups through the evidence mesh before counting corroboration.
Require complete sentence citations, fresh evidence, independent groups and adversarial review.

prohibited_interpretations: Do not treat aggregate measurements as claims about identifiable people.

Do not describe this output as human reporting or a human interview.
